env.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.description: Password for the admin account. Also works as an API bearer token.

env.name: SITE_TITLE
env.description: Title shown on the status page.

env.name: PUBLIC_DASHBOARD
env.description: Show the dashboard without signing in.

env.name: PASSWORD_LOGIN
env.description: Allow signing in with the admin password. Defaults to on, or off if Google sign-in is configured.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Google OAuth client ID. With the secret below, enables Sign in with Google.

env.name: ADMIN_EMAILS
env.description: Comma-separated Google accounts allowed to sign in (@domain.com for a whole Workspace domain).

env.name: NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL
env.description: Comma-separated webhook URLs (Discord, Slack, ntfy, or any JSON endpoint) for down/up/certificate alerts.

env.name: ALLOW_EMBED
env.description: Allow the dashboard to be shown in an iframe (Homepage, Heimdall, Home Assistant, ...).

env.name: PEERS
env.description: Comma-separated URLs of other Uptime Monitor deployments to federate with, shown as "Other servers" on the dashboard.

env.name: PEER_TOKEN
env.description: Shared secret used between federated servers (same value on every server in the group). Recommended whenever PEERS is set.
